title: A suspected leak warns in doctor, and leak checks wait for requests
why: A suspicion made doctor exit 1 with a misleading summary, and a pending call read as a leak. The summary names the failed gates.
changelog: `brain doctor` no longer fails on suspected leak B0601
Leak checks wait for in-flight requests
steps: To keep failing CI on a suspected leak, set `"doctor": { "failOnSuspectedLeaks": true }` in `brain.json`.
